summary: Kuber Resources Corp filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of Director and CFO Li Jiyong, effective April 10, 2026, citing alleged non-observance of an October 16, 2025 agreement and disagreements with management. The Board accepted the resignation, disagreeing with Li's statements and reserving rights to investigate. Raymond Fu was appointed CFO effective August 21, 2026, while retaining CEO, President, Secretary, and Treasurer roles, with no compensatory arrangements or family relationships disclosed. The filing is an abrupt officer/director departure, though the registrant's role is as the company itself, not as acquirer, target, seller, or issuer.
